name: Grammarly
summary: Writing assistant with a free plan and paid plans.
description: Grammarly checks and rewrites text in the browser and other apps. The homepage title on 21 October 2026 was “Grammarly: Free AI Writing Assistance”. The plans page is titled “Grammarly Prices and Plans”, so a paid tier exists, but the dollar amounts were not in the HTML that was fetched.
features: Real-Time Grammar and Spelling Checks: Instantly identifies and corrects grammatical errors and typos as you type.
Writing Style Improvements: Offers suggestions to improve clarity, conciseness, and tone.
Plagiarism Detection: Checks content against billions of web pages to ensure originality.
Tone Detection: Analyzes the tone of your writing to ensure it matches your intended message.

howToUse.title: Install & Log In
howToUse.description: Add Grammarly as a browser extension or use the web editor.

howToUse.title: Write or Paste Text
howToUse.description: Type or paste your content for real-time suggestions.

howToUse.title: Review & Accept Suggestions
howToUse.description: Check grammar, clarity, and tone feedback, then accept or ignore changes.

howToUse.title: Export or Share
howToUse.description: Copy, download, or share your improved writing.

features_fr: Vérifications grammaticales et orthographiques en temps réel : identifie et corrige instantanément les erreurs grammaticales et les fautes de frappe au fur et à mesure que vous tapez.
Améliorations du style d'écriture : propose des suggestions pour améliorer la clarté, la concision et le ton.
Détection du plagiat : vérifie le contenu par rapport à des milliards de pages Web pour garantir son originalité.
Détection de tonalité : analyse le ton de votre écriture pour garantir qu'elle correspond au message souhaité.
